denominator_policy.positive: variant side of a valid contract; expected violation
denominator_policy.control: original side of a valid contract; expected satisfied
denominator_policy.fn: positive not judged violation (satisfied or unknown; positive unknown counts as a miss)
denominator_policy.control_unknown: not counted as tn and not counted as fp
denominator_policy.paired_success: control satisfied AND positive violation for the same pair

denominator_policy_source.note: inherited unchanged; the evaluator code path is not modified

shared_evaluator_adapter.description: every column is scored through the frozen evaluator by canonicalising the in-memory method label; stored rows keep their true method id and no metric formula is reimplemented

v1_column_reference.note: the v1 column is not a comparison column this round; its per-item statuses are used for the v2-to-v3 change audit only
